description: This file contains function declarations related to asynchronous subscription management in the rbus (Robust Bus) communication framework. It includes function prototypes for adding, removing, and retrieving subscriptions, as well as closing handles. The file also includes necessary header guards and external references, with C linkage support.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_AddSubscription
methods.description: Registers a new asynchronous subscription with the specified event subscription details and payload.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_RemoveSubscription
methods.description: Removes an existing asynchronous subscription based on the provided subscription details.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_GetSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves an existing subscription handle based on provided handle, event name, and filter.

methods.name: rbusAsyncSubscribe_CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the specified handle used for subscription management.
